chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله designated al-'Aqiq as the miqat for the people of Iraq. Its beginning is al-Maslakh, its middle is Ghamrah, and its end is Dhat 'Irq. Its beginning is more virtuous.

key_terms.الْعَقِيقَ: the miqat designated for the people of Iraq
key_terms.الْعِرَاقِ: the people of Iraq addressed in this ruling
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.وَقَّتَ: appointed or designated a fixed time/place

ai.seo_question: What is the miqat for the people of Iraq, and which part of al-'Aqiq is most virtuous?
ai.summary: This hadith states the appointed miqat for the people of Iraq for entering ihram, identifying al-'Aqiq and describing its beginning, middle, and end points. It also indicates that beginning from its earliest point, al-Maslakh, is more virtuous.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2526 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) designated Al-‘Aqiq as the miqat for the people of Iraq. Its beginning is Al-Maslakhu, its middle is Ghamrah, and its end is Dhat Irq. The beginning (Al-Maslakhu) is the most virtuous."
